question: Starting from identical mature particle positions and leapfrog half-step velocities, when do the self-consistent charge and field trajectories first differ materially?

basis.observed_before_declaration: The independently evolved phase-0.3 field deficit is present in the first measured cycle and persists, but that experiment cannot locate divergence from a common state. No output from this collision-free common-state trace has been observed.

physics_contract.phase_reason: AuroraPIC retained field at horizon zero must equal eduPIC's first pre-push field after eduPIC advances Time by one electron timestep.
physics_contract.endpoint_field: charged half-cell Gauss correction enabled in both codes

sampling_contract.mapping: eduPIC pre-push step k and AuroraPIC retained field after k-1 completed steps use the same particle time level and RF field time.

reduction_contract.profile_relative_rms: sqrt(integral((A-N)^2) / max(integral(N^2),1e-300)) with trapezoidal endpoint integration
reduction_contract.critical_field_energy_ratio: regional mean-square AuroraPIC field divided by regional mean-square eduPIC field
reduction_contract.population_comparison: live electron and ion macro-particle counts at every matched horizon
reduction_contract.material_field_divergence: full-domain field relative RMS greater than 0.01 or critical field-energy ratio outside [0.98,1.02]
reduction_contract.sustained_divergence: material field divergence at a sample and the next two samples
reduction_contract.initial_parity_gate: at horizon zero, charge and field relative RMS are each at most 2e-6 and the critical field-energy ratio lies in [0.995,1.005]

prospective_decision_rule.integrity_gate: all hashes, signatures, source transforms, output shapes, coordinates, phases, populations, finite values, and resource limits match
prospective_decision_rule.one_step_mover_or_boundary_mismatch_if: initial parity passes but sustained material divergence begins at AuroraPIC horizon 1 or 2
prospective_decision_rule.later_nonlinear_divergence_if: initial parity passes, horizons through 20 are below material thresholds, and sustained divergence begins later
prospective_decision_rule.collision_free_trajectory_agreement_if: initial parity passes and no sustained material divergence occurs through horizon 3999

claim_boundary: This experiment isolates deterministic collision-free 1D electrostatic evolution from one mature common particle state. It cannot test collision-kernel equivalence, preserve RNG trajectories, establish experimental agreement, establish a published benchmark pass, validate other states or dimensions, or prove general PIC correctness.
